observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor dance hall with wooden parquet floor, tables, chairs, and a small stage in the background
observation.dancers: one couple, a man and a woman
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing in closed ballroom hold, traveling counterclockwise around the room
observation.posture: upright ballroom posture with straight torsos, soft knees, and continuous weight shifts
observation.footwork: smooth walking steps and side closes on the beat, blending forward and backward progression with swivelling steps
observation.arms_and_hands: closed ballroom dance hold with arms elevated and extended outwards in standard frame
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, maintaining frame while turning and progressing
observation.partnering: closed dance hold with continuous physical connection and coordinated lead and follow
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level throughout, incorporating turns and pivots with no jumps or floor work
observation.costume_and_props: man in black button-down shirt, black trousers, and light tie; woman in black top and long black flared skirt with low-heeled dance shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot pressure and micro-rhythms due to low-resolution video sampling

signature_moments.what: a progressive walking sequence traveling forward in closed ballroom hold
a pivoting turn sequence where the couple rotates together
side-by-side walking steps followed by a curved step and tap
